title: Editor Local Loopback Dev Runner Checklist

items.label: Capture existing Editor browser/live Backend smoke evidence, Backend server entrypoint, Core package boundary, and terminology before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-local-loopback-dev-runner-2026-08-28 records the exact Editor commit, existing loopback context, and dependency boundaries used for the dev runner.
items.verificationNote: Project Control loopback smoke documents, Editor scripts, Backend src/server.ts and /health route, Core AGENTS.md, Backend AGENTS.md, Editor AGENTS.md, and product terminology were read before implementation.

items.label: Define the runner as a local development orchestration command, not product runtime behavior or evidence promotion.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-local-loopback-dev-runner-2026-08-28 shows the runner reports local loopback scope, live Backend mode, Core dependency-only status, and no evidence fixture writes.
items.verificationNote: The dry-run test verifies scope.localLoopbackOnly true, scope.liveBackendMode true, scope.evidenceFixtureWrite false, and scope.productionReadinessClaim false.

items.label: Add the Editor-owned runner and npm commands for one-command local loopback startup.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-local-loopback-dev-runner-2026-08-28 points to the runner script, package scripts, and test that protect the command shape.
items.verificationNote: Editor commit a007817b0f21de758e93a7c0b63873ca0414d5a7 adds scripts/run-local-loopback-dev.mjs, dev:local-loopback, dev:local-loopback:smoke, and src/tests/localLoopbackDevRunner.test.ts.

items.label: Verify the runner can start a Backend loopback server and Editor Vite server, wait for readiness, and stop cleanly.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-local-loopback-dev-runner-2026-08-28 records the smoke command that starts Backend and Editor on random ports and reaches Backend /health plus Editor /documents.
items.verificationNote: npm run dev:local-loopback:smoke passed in the Editor worktree with random loopback ports and exited after readiness.

items.label: Register Project Control evidence for the bounded dev runner result without turning the development command into product readiness truth.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-local-loopback-dev-runner-2026-08-28 cites exact commits, paths, commands, supported claims, risks, and unknowns.
items.verificationNote: The evidence record is work-scoped with nodeIds empty and repositoryId repo-editor.

items.label: Keep Editor, Backend, Core, and FlowDoc broad truth states unchanged by this local development runner lane.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-local-loopback-dev-runner-2026-08-28 remains work-scoped and does not add documentIds or evidenceIds to the Editor Project Control Node.
items.verificationNote: The Editor Project Control Node remains truthState unknown with empty documentIds and evidenceIds.
